profile.headline: Software Engineer at Intercontinental Exchange
profile.summary: I am an experienced software engineer with a passion for web application development.  I have solid experience and proven programming skills in all phases of the software design life cycle.  Extensive background in Object Oriented and Internet-related technologies including ASP.NET Framework, C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET Web API, jQuery, jQuery UI, Angular, AngularJS, Bootstrap, KnockoutJS, TypeScript, Visual Studio, Transact-SQL and Microsoft SQL Server.

positions.title: Web Developer Team Lead
positions.description:
Responsible for leading a team of web developers and managing all facets of web development projects including project prioritization, planning design, development, execution, implementation and testing.

Oversee development of internal and external websites.

Develop team design, coding, testing standards.
